messages.subject: Project Indigo - investor consent & deed of release
messages.plaintextBody:
Aisha,

Caspian is finalising the Aerelon licence. Ravensworth's debenture catches the licensed patents, so we need (a) investor consent to the licence and (b) a short deed of release / non-disturbance over the patents in the schedule. Draft to follow this week - grateful if you could route for signature ahead of a mid-March signing.

James

—
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
